mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing betamethasone levels; corticosteroids may increase paroxetine metabolism and reduce SSRI efficacy while increasing psychiatric and behavioral side effects.
action: Monitor for reduced paroxetine efficacy and increased depression/anxiety symptoms; consider alternative antidepressant or glucocorticoid; baseline psychiatric assessment recommended if betamethasone doses are substantial or long-term.
